title: Sleep next to the work calendar
description: Line up logged sleep with work commitments, while keeping control of the next wake-up time.

blocks.text: A suggested wake-up time is useless if you already have to be at work by then. The calendar helps make that constraint visible before the alarm is set.

quote.text: However, the app decided that my ideal wake up time is 7:30. Guess who needs to be at work at 7:30? So I tried to make adjustments and I couldn’t.

blocks.text: Show work events alongside the sleep history. The person sets the available time themselves and distinguishes a one-off shift from a new standing schedule.

An empty slot in the calendar doesn’t mean free time: there may be a commute and personal errands. A window found that way must not be passed off as a calculation of the recovery someone needs or as the body’s optimal routine.
